obligations.text: Where remote.merge_queue.required is true, governance, preflight, supply-chain, workflow-lint, sg-scan and secret-scan are skipped on a push, and the policy's push rule for them, code and every declared extra job is post-merge.
On a post-merge push, code runs its cache steps: the spec-spine cache, a lookup of the cargo key, and only on a miss the build that fills it and the save.

ci-gate runs on the push and admits a post-merge job that succeeded or was skipped only when the pushed commit's latest completed merge-queue run of statecraft-ci has a successful ci-gate job; a failed, cancelled or vanished job, a commit no queue run judged, a failed queue gate and an unreadable record each block.

With a required queue, every declared extra job and an external code call receive the boolean input post_merge, true on a push, and run where preflight is skipped; the plan refuses a called workflow that does not declare the input.
Without a required queue, the rendered jobs, their conditions and the policy's push rules are those of revision 23.

Rendering tests show the post-merge form only under a required queue, the cache steps, the policy rules and the called workflows' input and refusal; ci-gate.sh, run as a program, admits and blocks each post-merge case, and every new blocking branch is noticed when inverted.
A revision-23 project upgrades to revision 24 in one plan, with and without a required queue, and a second plan writes nothing.

sectionHeadings: 067: A post-merge push runs only the cache saves and the gate
record.summary: Amends specs 002, 032, 044 and 058. Where the policy records a required merge queue, the queue has already judged the exact commit a push to the default branch carries. github-actions-rust revision 24 skips every job that judges on that push, keeps the cache steps, and has ci-gate admit the skips by an explicit post-merge rule only when the pushed commit passed ci-gate in its merge-queue run. Repo-owned called workflows receive a boolean post_merge input. Without a required queue nothing changes.
record.title: Setup profile revision 24: where the merge queue is required, a push to the default branch runs only the cache saves and ci-gate
